title: Effective geometrostatics of spherical stars beyond general relativity
summary: We provide a set of general tools to study the problem of stellar equilibrium in any gravitational theory in which spherically symmetric spacetimes satisfy master field equations taking the form of an equality between an identically conserved tensor, with derivatives of up to second order in the metric, and an identically conserved matter tensor. We derive the most general expression for the Tolman--Oppenheimer--Volkoff equation of stellar equilibrium that is compatible with these minimal requirements.
